search_scope: Focused retrieval following the repository bibliography; not a systematic review or exhaustive prior-art search. No current journal-quartile verification performed.

sources.title: OpenWatch: A Multimodal Benchmark for Hand Gesture Recognition on Smartwatches
sources.supported_use: 50 participants, over 10 hours, 59 labelled gesture sequences, subject-independent evaluation; PPG benefit of 12.5 F1 points is scoped to foundation smartwatch models
sources.boundary: Sequence/classification benchmark; not comparable directly with continuous event recall or false activations per eligible negative hour; preprint status does not establish a journal quartile

sources.title: Robust Finger Interactions with COTS Smartwatches via Unsupervised Siamese Adaptation
sources.retrieval: Author-hosted primary PDF downloaded and text extracted successfully
sources.supported_use: Prior work on COTS smartwatch finger interaction and unsupervised Siamese adaptation
sources.boundary: No project-equivalent continuous performance baseline was reproduced; adaptation protocol must not be conflated with a frozen model

sources.title: Thumb-to-Finger Gesture Recognition Using COTS Smartwatch Accelerometers
sources.retrieval: Author-hosted primary PDF downloaded and text extracted successfully
sources.supported_use: 12 recruited participants; abstract reports 94.7% for four gestures under leave-one-participant-out and 90.2% for 11 gestures under participant-specific leave-one-session-out evaluation
sources.boundary: Recognition accuracy is not continuous event recall at a matched false-activation budget

sources.title: Principal component analysis of photoplethysmography signals for improved gesture recognition
sources.retrieval: Publisher primary full-text HTML retrieved successfully
sources.supported_use: 14 subjects, green/red/infrared signals, sitting/walking/jogging/running conditions and SVM/KNN classifiers
sources.boundary: Does not establish low everyday continuous false-activation rates for this project or justify fitting PCA on test data
